name: Firecrawl
purpose: Server-side web search, scrape, crawl and extraction for Source Library and research workflows.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: Create an API key in the Firecrawl dashboard. It is sent only as an Authorization Bearer credential.

cannot_infer: a valid Firecrawl key proves API access for its team; it does not approve credit spend, crawling a specific site, or downstream publication

name: OpenRouter
purpose: Routes model requests across the OpenRouter catalogue when a reviewed model allocation selects it.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: Create a workload-specific OpenRouter API key. Prefer a key with an explicit spending limit.

cannot_infer: a valid OpenRouter key proves API authentication; it does not approve model choice, provider routing, BYOK use, or spend

name: GroqCloud
purpose: Low-latency hosted model inference when a reviewed model allocation selects Groq.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: Create a GroqCloud API key for the intended project or environment.

cannot_infer: a valid Groq key proves API authentication; it does not approve a model, data classification, rate-limit use, or spend

name: Cohere
purpose: Cohere model inference, embeddings and reranking when a reviewed model allocation selects Cohere.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: Create a trial or production Cohere API key in the dashboard.

cannot_infer: a valid Cohere key proves API authentication; it does not establish production entitlement, model suitability, or spend approval
